analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($526.47) vs SMA5/20/50 ($549.19/$579.41/$596.83) — trading below short/mid-term moving averages, indicating a weak position.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($524.16/$448.30) — above long-term moving averages, maintaining strength.
· 52-week position (63.0%) + current price level is historically mid-range.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (33.3→36.5) + attempting a slight recovery after entering oversold territory.
· MACD histogram trajectory (hist -6.7920→hist -6.7920) + holding in negative territory without improvement, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $528.87) + band width at 17.44% indicates an expansion phase.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($374.24) + based on long-term moving averages.
· Swing resistance ($581.17) + breaking this level could lead to recovery towards the middle band.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (5-day low $505.13, 20-day low $505.13) — maintaining a sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.75x) + low confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (distribution phase) + 'wait and see' condition for 5 consecutive days.
